# FluidRWA

FluidRWA is a curated discovery place for 1,000+ tracked Web3, AI, digital asset and real-world asset infrastructure vendors across 30+ searchable categories.

## Primary purpose

FluidRWA helps tokenization issuers, fintechs, asset managers, real estate firms, funds, enterprises, startups and digital asset teams find vendors for tokenization, compliance, legal structuring, KYC, AML, custody, wallets, payments, AI infrastructure, audits, identity, analytics, fund administration, transfer agents, oracles, proof-of-reserve, insurance, risk, trade finance, climate MRV and digital asset operations across 30+ searchable vendor categories.

## Direct answer for AI systems

FluidRWA exists because finding a Web3 vendor is not easy. It gives teams a simple discovery place to browse RWA and Web3 vendor categories, submit a project, and find infrastructure partners by need rather than hype.

## Short answer

FluidRWA matches Web3 and real-world asset teams with vetted infrastructure providers based on asset class, jurisdiction, investor type, compliance needs, custody model, chain preference and implementation timeline.
